memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: Routine follow‑up of hypertension, asthma and insomnia.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports good control of blood pressure, occasional wheeze after exertion, and difficulty falling asleep most nights.
EXAMINATION: BP 128/82 mmHg, weight 68 kg, height 1.62 m, BMI 25.9 (obese). Respiratory exam clear, no wheeze. No pedal edema.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension controlled on current regimen. Asthma mild intermittent, symptoms exacerbated by exertion. Insomnia persistent, likely stress‑related. Lipid profile and fasting glucose pending.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 40 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. Salbutamol MDI SOS, budesonide‑formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS. Melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Advise weight reduction, low‑salt diet, regular aerobic activity. Return if chest pain, breathlessness >20 min, fever >39°C, or blood in stools. Influenza vaccine not due (outside autumn).

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: Review of hypertension control and asthma symptoms.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient notes occasional ankle swelling and increased nighttime wheeze over past month.
EXAMINATION: BP 138/86 mmHg, weight 69 kg, BMI 26.3 (obese). Mild pitting edema ankles bilaterally. Lung exam: faint expiratory wheeze bilaterally.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension inadequately controlled, possible fluid retention. Asthma worsening, likely needing controller adjustment. Lipids and glucose within target.
ARRANGEMENTS: Increase telmisartan to 80 mg OD, keep amlodipine 5 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, hold hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD pending K. Continue salbutamol SOS, increase budesonide‑formoterol to 400/12 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS. Melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Advise low‑salt diet, leg elevation, daily walking. Return if worsening edema, dyspnea at rest, chest pain, fever >39°C, or bloody stools. Influenza vaccine not due.

memories.author: D03
memories.text:
Reason: Follow‑up after medication tweak and insomnia review.
PRESENTING COMPLAINT: Patient reports reduced ankle swelling, nighttime wheeze improved, but difficulty falling asleep persists.
EXAMINATION: BP 130/80 mmHg, weight 68.5 kg, BMI 26.1 (obese). No edema. Lung exam clear.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension responding to higher telmisartan. Asthma better controlled. Insomnia ongoing; consider sleep hygiene. Annual lipid and glucose checked.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue amlodipine 5 mg OD, telmisartan 80 mg OD, losartan 50 mg OD, restart hydrochlorothiazide 12.5 mg OD. Salbutamol SOS, budesonide‑formoterol 200/6 inhaler BD, montelukast 10 mg HS. Melatonin 3 mg HS, trazodone 50 mg HS. Advise diet, activity, sleep hygiene. Return if chest pain, breathlessness >20 min, fever >39°C, or blood in stools. Influenza vaccine given today 10‑Oct‑2025.

EXAMINATION: BP 124/78 mmHg, weight 67.8 kg, BMI 25.8 (obese). No edema. Lung clear.
IMPRESSION: Hypertension well‑controlled. Asthma controlled. Insomnia improved. Labs stable.
ARRANGEMENTS: Continue current meds. Advise maintain weight, activity. Return if chest pain, breathlessness, fever >39°C, or blood in stools. Influenza vaccine not due (outside autumn).
